checksPage.theEndpointsFileIsNot: The endpoints file is not applied
checksPage.theEndpointsFileHasSomething: The endpoints file has something to fix
checksPage.aStaleCheckHasHad: A stale check has had no result for three of its intervals: the runner stopped, or cannot reach Uptime. See
checksPage.theyComeFromTheEndpointsFile: Checks come from the endpoints file the install keeps, the one Certificates reads too: set OPENASY_ENDPOINTS to it. Every entry is a check, such as:
checksPage.addedHereBefore_one: {{count}} check was added here before the file
checksPage.addedHereBefore_other: {{count}} checks were added here before the file
checksPage.copyTheseIntoTheEndpointsFile: They keep running. Copy these lines into the endpoints file: once an entry has the same name, it takes the check over with its results and outages.

checkPage.fromTheEndpointsFileChange: From the endpoints file: change or remove it there. It can still be paused here.
checkPage.pausedRunnersSkipItAnd: Paused: runners skip it, and the status page shows it as maintenance.
checkPage.noResultForThreeIntervals: No result for three intervals: the runner stopped, or cannot reach Uptime. The last known state is not shown as current.
checkPage.noRunnerHasRunIt: No runner has run it. See
checkPage.itsResultsAndOutagesAre: Its results and outages are deleted with it, and it leaves the status page.
checkPage.copyThisIntoTheEndpointsFile: It keeps running. Copy this into the endpoints file: once the entry is there, it takes the check over with its results and outages.

outagesPage.anOutageStartsWhenA: An outage starts when a check goes down and ends with its next passing result. Ended outages are kept for 400 days.
outagesPage.everyCheckThatHasReported: Every check that has reported is up or degraded.

setupPage.addChecksHereThenRun: Add checks here, then run the runner from where your users are: a CI cron, a server in another network, or several. Uptime itself probes nothing.
setupPage.theRunnerIsOneScript: The runner is one script with no dependencies, served by this Uptime. Use UPTIME_INGEST_TOKEN, set where uptime runs, or an API token with the editor role from API tokens.
setupPage.fromCronOrASystemd: From cron or a systemd timer. Node 20 or later.
setupPage.oneFailureMakesACheck: One failure makes a check degraded; the failures you set in a row make it down and open an outage. One pass makes it up.
setupPage.aCheckWithNoResult: A check with no result for three of its intervals is stale: the page says the runner stopped instead of showing an old state as current.
setupPage.thePublicStatusPageIs: The public status page is at
setupPage.plainHtmlWithNoScript: , plain HTML with no script. It shows only checks marked public, by name, group and state; a paused check shows as maintenance.

settingsPage.askAnAdminOfThis: Ask an admin of this uptime for access.
